name: Tarogong

queries.query: Tarogong Garut peta bidang tanah persil BPN BHUMI peta kadaster resmi
queries.scope: Locate city-specific cadastral/parcel registry and query a public full polygon at the WUP point.
queries.result: The official BHUMI map documents the national “Bidang Tanah” parcel layer and map-search tools. Its public client references `umum:Persil` and an `expapi/getPersil` feature-info route. At Tarogong’s bounded WUP coordinate, an unauthenticated read-only POST returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized; the direct WMS GetCapabilities request returned HTTP 200 with an XML service exception (`NumberFormatException: undefined`) instead of capabilities. No full geometry was returned. Garut local-government sources document countywide land certification but do not establish target-point parcel coverage, so the local registry flag remains unverified.
queries.executionMethod: Indonesian-language primary-source search; inspected current BHUMI viewer HTML/JavaScript and its public layer metadata; issued bounded anonymous feature-info and WMS capability requests at the WUP point.

queries.query: Tarogong Garut official land parcel map cadastral registry BPN GIS full geometry
queries.scope: Cross-check city-specific primary coverage and public vector access.
queries.result: The official BPN BHUMI help page describes an interactive national land map with parcel-related search and the live viewer client names the `Bidang Tanah` (`umum:Persil`) layer. However, neither an unauthenticated WUP-point query nor direct WMS capabilities returned a parcel feature. Garut official sources show countywide PTSL/land-certificate activity, but do not identify a target-area parcel service or parcel at the Tarogong WUP point. Registry presence for this city label is therefore left null pending city-specific map/registry evidence.
